[A36] [MEDIUM] The README's release section is fiction, and the semantics of [package].version are undocumented
[A35] [INFO] forge-std pinned at 1.16.1; 1.16.2 is the latest published revision
[A34] [INFO] Two low-risk conventions: test-only libraries carry the concrete `=` pragma, and slither's filter_paths is unanchored
[A33] [LOW] Naming: single-letter parameters on the two most dangerous functions, and two misnamed matrix test contracts
[A32] [LOW] Bare src/ and test/ import paths in all 28 test files
[A31] [LOW] .gas-snapshot is a committed generated artifact, stale by three test contracts, with nothing regenerating or diffing it
[A30] [LOW] Twelve dead `using ... for` directives, one of them stranding an import a test depends on
[A29] [LOW] forge build emits two warnings, and foundry.lock is a dead file contradicting the real forge-std pin
[A28] [LOW] CI triggers on push only, so pull requests from forks get no checks at all
[A27] [LOW] Release workflow has no concurrency group, so two close merges race one version and can wedge the pipeline
[A26] [MEDIUM] Nothing records that the Protofire-audited commit has drifted 74 commits behind main
[A25] [MEDIUM] Auto-publish can only emit patch bumps and ships no notes, so a memory-corruption fix is indistinguishable from a comment tweak
[A24] [MEDIUM] The cancun/mcopy floor is stripped out of the published package and asserted nowhere
[A23] [LOW] One truncation condition, two error types, and the shared error lives in a uint256-named file
[A22] [LOW] unsafeExtend NatSpec names parameters base_/extend_ that do not exist, and LibBytes32Array documents every bytes32 as an integer
[A21] [LOW] LibStackPointer library doc is stale on three counts: a StackPointer type, a uint256 element type, and up/down functions that do not exist
[A20] [MEDIUM] LibStackSentinel NatSpec: MissingSentinel documents an unreachable trigger, the underflow bound is wrong by 32x, and two reverts are undocumented
[A19] [LOW] README misdescribes the library surface: dedup-sort, copy and slicing do not exist, and no error surface is documented
[A18] [LOW] NatSpec completeness sweep: library docs missing or malformed on 6 of 9 libraries, and itemCount/flatten/truncate lack @param/@return

[A09] [LOW] LibStackSentinel and unsafeList: n == 1, sentinel-valued tuple data, the below-lower boundary and unsafeList at maximum length are all untested
[A08] [LOW] LibPointer: the documented pointer wrap is never exercised, and unsafeWriteWord's write extent is unpinned (both mutation-proven survivors)
[A07] [MEDIUM] unsafeExtend branch tests assert contents only and never pin which branch executed
[A06] [MEDIUM] No deterministic flatten test places an empty inner array anywhere but last, so a write-cursor bug at an empty-array boundary is caught only by a 100-run fuzz
[A05] [MEDIUM] The only test for the documented underflow-reverts-via-gas guarantee uses a bare vm.expectRevert and provably passes on inputs that never underflow
